value.author: Prokhorova
value.title: We had a nice stay
value.text:
The hotel and stuff is really nice and helpful. Though the hotel is a bit old, it sleeps amazing there! Rooms are pretty small but enough, and beds are narrow, but even with all this being said, we slept like babies! Each room has an ocean view. And the small park in front of the hotel is really nice, especially at night.
Be aware of the sandflies at the restaurant (which is overpriced even having one of the best sunset views) which bite terriblyб and the bites then hurt and itch for a long time!
— Sandflies - I hope there is something staff can do with them. Otherwise everything is good.

value.title: رائع
value.text:
Loved the location and how close it was to restaurants and shopping driving distance.  The room was comfy and clean for what we needed. The staff at the front desk was helpful and polite. Beach was less 200 ft away.
— Some staff is not so friendly.  Never got a good morning or hello when passing by them. Other than that, we will come back again.

value.author: Gary
value.title: We always enjoy staying here!
value.text:
We've been here repeated times which tells you a lot.  We love the suite room which has a TV room and a kitchenette.  This was the first time we got an ocean view room and we loved it!  

The Turtle Club restaurant with ocean view tables has outstanding food...a little price but you are paying for the view.

The pool area and garden walkway with palm trees and orchids is very nice.
— Since they had to rebuild from the hurricane they should have added sound proofing to the rooms.

The kitchen had sparse pots and pans, not a single non stick frying pan.

The front desk staff seemed to be bothered that I used Booking.com but I explained that I looked direct and their were no ocean view rooms but there were on Booking.  Also he refused to explain the $45 per day charge.

The beach now is very tiny compared to before.  They expanded the outdoor seating for the restaurant, too much, which takes up a lot of the beach.  This was off season, can't imagine how tight the beach is during season.
